hook.name: SpawnHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Spawn token-launch platform that applies directional static LP fees (different rates for buying vs selling the spawn token, configured at pool initialization). Protocol fees are explicitly disabled (PROTOCOL_FEE_NUMERATOR = 0). The hook also supports a temporary MEV-protection module that can raise LP fees during the first hour after pool creation.
